text: Hour one. Your hand goes to your pocket. Nothing there. Ten minutes later... again. You're in a queue, and your thumb is scrolling... nothing. Just air. Then your leg buzzes. {deadpan} Your phone is in a drawer at home. {neutral} That's called phantom vibration. In one study, eighty-nine percent of students felt it. Your brain has been trained so well... it's now making up notifications. {deadpan} Thirty days, it says. Easy. It's been one hour.
